human_tolerance.notes: Since about 1900 has expanded from cliffs into urban habitats, bombed areas and large industrial complexes with bare, cliff-like buildings; nests in such areas and will catch passing insects in flight.

phases.name: breeding
phases.note: Breeding starts in mid-April (Wikipedia). The end of July is an authored judgement from the 13-17 day incubation and 12-19 day fledging periods, not a sourced date.

vocalizations.description: Rattling song given from a song perch, often from a roof or wall, with a short tick call as a companion sound.
Short tick call. Wikipedia describes this call without giving its function; using it as the alarm call is an authored mapping.

taxonomy.note: GBIF usageKey 5739315 is the accepted species (checked 2026-10-31). ITIS TSN 562036 is 'valid' for Phoenicurus ochruros (Gmelin, 1774). Wikidata P685 lists TSN 358815, which I could not resolve to this taxon; not used.

external.note: iNaturalist taxon 13000 (species rank, active) via Wikidata P3151 and the iNaturalist API. Wikidata P846 matches GBIF 5739315.

range.note: Country list derived from Wikipedia prose: breeds from Great Britain and Ireland south to Morocco, widespread in south and central Europe. Not checked against occurrence status; Asian and eastern countries omitted.

traits.limb_count.note: Two legs; wings not counted, per schema convention.

traits.locomotion_modes.note: Flight from Wikipedia; hop from the chosen behaviour program's ground-feeding gait, not a source.

traits.perching.note: Wikipedia says it nests in crevices, holes and on ledges; perching is inferred from the passerine family and the cited perched behaviour.

traits.nest_type.note: Nests in crevices or holes in rock or buildings (Cavity).

traits.mass_kg.note: EltonTraits BodyMass-Value 16.5 g (Dunning 2008 reference), converted to kg.

traits.mass_range_kg.note: Wikipedia gives 12-20 g; converted to kg.

traits.length_m.note: Midpoint of 13-14.5 cm (Wikipedia), converted to metres.

traits.lifespan_y.note: PROXY, not a black redstart value. No openly licensed typical wild lifespan was found for this species (searched 2026-10-31). Uses the European robin's 1.1 years (Wikipedia: average life expectancy, driven by first-year mortality) as a close passerine relative. Replace with a black redstart value when a source is available.

traits.diet.note: EltonTraits Diet-Inv 60, Diet-Fruit 30, Diet-Seed 10 (percent of diet), divided by 100. Diet-Vend, Vect, Vfish, Vunk, Scav, Nect and PlantO are 0.

traits.social.note: Wikipedia: usually monogamous. Solitary with group_size 1-2 is an authored mapping of a territorial pair.

traits.activity_pattern.note: Forages and sings by day (Wikipedia mentions foraging in flight and by day); classed as Diurnal.

traits.defense.note: judgement: flees to a perch when disturbed (Wikipedia: quick ducks of head and body, tail flicked).

traits.wariness.note: judgement, not a measured value. Urban adapter with close approach to people.

habitat.use.note: EltonTraits ForStrat-ground 60 and ForStrat-understory 40, divided by 100. Understory is mapped to arboreal; that mapping is an assumption.

habitat.resources.note: Invertebrate weight 0.6 from EltonTraits Diet-Inv. Cavity and cliff/perch tags from Wikipedia nesting and habitat text. Weights are authored.

habitat.human_tolerance.note: Wikipedia: expanded since about 1900 into urban and industrial habitats.

seasonal.strategy.note: Resident in the milder parts of its range; north-eastern birds migrate. No winter fraction is sourced, so winter_fraction is omitted.

seasonal.phases.note: Breeding start mid-April from Wikipedia. The end date is an authored judgement.

activity.note: Activity curves fetched by tools/fetch_activity.py for FR.

behavior.note: bt-perching-songbird-v1 with alarm call overridden to 'tick' and nesting months 4-6. Limitations: song is not restricted to months; the program triggers song on sun elevation only.

look.note: judgement: palette and proportions are authored from the Wikipedia plumage description (male dark grey to black upperparts, black breast, orange-red rump and tail; grey wing panel in western forms).

habitat.shelter_tag.note: Generic shelter tag. Wikipedia places the species on cliffs, rock faces and buildings; no specific tag exists for these.

seasonal.life_stages.note: Egg, juvenile and adult stages. Wikipedia gives incubation (13-17 days) and fledging (12-19 days) periods; no durations are recorded.

seasonal.winter_fraction.note: judgement, not a sourced value. Wikipedia says northern and eastern birds migrate and milder-range birds are resident; 0.8 assumes most western European birds stay for winter. Replace with a sourced share when available.

vocalizations.song.note: Rattling song from Wikipedia. Cooldown, time windows and loudness are authored judgement; season_months is empty (year-round), which overstates winter song.

vocalizations.tick.note: Tick call from Wikipedia without a stated function. Its use as the alarm call is an authored mapping (judgement).
